subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 wake replay foundation

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this native durable-runtime stack and accept persisted wake/replay semantics as core architecture?
rationale: The PR introduces a new persistent core runtime and delivery contract across a multi-PR stack; mechanical fixes cannot determine permanent ownership or release commitment.

options.title: Sponsor after safety gates
options.body: Accept the durable-runtime direction after replay ownership, crash-boundary behavior, schema coverage, upgrade proof, live proof, and the upstream dependency are resolved.

options.title: Require a narrower design
options.body: Ask for a smaller architecture that reuses existing task, subagent, and delivery owners before adding another persistent runtime ledger.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Keep this dependent PR unlanded if maintainers do not want to sponsor a native durable-runtime subsystem.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after safety gates
recommendation.body: Accept the durable-runtime direction after replay ownership, crash-boundary behavior, schema coverage, upgrade proof, live proof, and the upstream dependency are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history makes steipete the strongest adjacent owner for shared state, gateway/session behavior, and cross-cutting core direction.
